items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Oh, yeah, every gig, [inaudible] they had Scoops Carey.

ctx.x: Olhan Brothers, yes, but they had a bunch of people that came from New Orleans there that was really doing it. Jimmy Noone and the bunch. They could do it in the box, you know, and the guys that played clarinet. A lot of clarinet players came up.
Oh, yeah, every gig, [inaudible] they had Scoops Carey.
Bob — oh God what was his name, the trumpet player? Real black cat, man, Bob something, he was a lead trumpet player, a beautiful trumpet. Bob something.
